questions.stem_text: Suppose that there are only two goods: x and y. Which of the following is NOT correct?

options.A: One can have comparative advantage in producing both goods.
options.B: One can have both an absolute advantage and a comparative advantage in producing x.
options.C: One can have absolute advantage and no comparative advantage in producing x.
options.D: One can have comparative advantage and no absolute advantage in producing x.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - One can have comparative advantage in producing both goods.

questions.stem_text: The primary focus of microeconomics is

options.A: the overall national economy and its growth.
options.B: the impact of government regulations on businesses.
options.C: the stock market and its fluctuations.
options.D: the economic impact of natural disasters.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the overall national economy and its growth.

questions.stem_text:
If technology makes production less expensive and at the same time exports decrease which
of the following will result with certainty?

options.C: The country's trade balance will worsen.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Real GDP will decrease.
